info.title: Adobe Analytics Marketing Channels API
info.description:
The Adobe Analytics Marketing Channels API retrieves the marketing channel configurations for one or more report suites. Although this is a retrieval operation, it uses the POST method (not GET) so that a list of report suite IDs can be supplied in the request body. This endpoint does not create or modify marketing channels.

 Note: Adobe may add optional request and response members (name/value pairs) to existing API objects at any time and without notice or changes in versioning. Adobe recommends that you refer to the API documentation of any third-party tool you integrate with our APIs so that such additions are ignored in processing if not understood. If implemented properly, such additions are non-breaking changes for your implementation. Adobe will not remove parameters or add required parameters without first providing standard notification through release notes.

post.summary: Retrieve marketing channels for report suites
post.description: Retrieves the marketing channel configurations for one or more report suites. This endpoint uses the POST method (not GET) so that a list of report suite IDs can be supplied in the request body; it does not create or modify marketing channels.

parameters.name: globalCompanyId
parameters.description: The Global Company ID for the Adobe Analytics organization.

200.description: A list of report suites, each with its configured marketing channels.

400.description: Invalid input. rsidList is required and must be non-empty.

403.description: The user does not have access to a requested report suite.

404.description: A requested report suite could not be found.

rsidList.description: A list of report suite IDs for which to retrieve marketing channel configurations. Required and must be non-empty.

rsid.description: The report suite ID that the returned marketing channels belong to.

marketingChannels.description: The list of marketing channels configured for the report suite.

channelId.description: Unique identifier for the marketing channel within the report suite.

name.description: Display name of the marketing channel.

enabled.description: Whether the marketing channel is enabled for the report suite.

color.description: Hexadecimal color code (without the leading #) used to display the channel in the interface.

channelBreakdown.description: A numeric indicator of how the channel is broken down in reporting.

overrideLastTouchChannel.description: Whether this channel overrides the last-touch channel in attribution.

authorization.name: Authorization
authorization.description: The access token copied from your AA API client integration, prefixed with "Bearer ".

x-api-key.name: x-api-key
x-api-key.description: The API key copied from your AA API client integration.
